messages:
Alice Chen: Heads-up — we need to lock down the ops plan for the upcoming SDK breaking changes. Partners + marketplace + SI integrations all need a clear ‘breakguard’ path. Who can own the partner-facing comms?
Miguel Santos: I can take comms + marketplace coordination. Will draft an email + marketplace banner copy. Want a 4‑week canary before public sunset.
Sophie Patel: I'll own the SDK shim and compatibility tests. Planning a 2-week internal canary then 4‑week partner canary. Need partner test harnesses from SI teams.
Ben Li: Engineering note: runtime accepts both old auth header and new token header but we should avoid relying on indeterminate fallback long-term. Will put a hard deprecation flag behind a feature toggle.
Jordan Park: For hardware partners (NVIDIA cloud, Habana OEMs) we need to confirm client binary compatibility for quantized kernels. I'll ping HW partner leads; request: provide smoke test matrix by EOD Fri.
Sara (Partner Success): Can we give partners a single-runbook doc? They asked for rollback instructions and a compatibility checklist. I'll collate partner questions from last two months.
partner-bot: Reminder: scheduled marketplace banner draft due in 3 days.
Alice Chen: Good. Miguel—please coordinate legal-approved wording for the marketplace notice. Sophie—include a lightweight code snippet partners can paste to detect version at runtime.
Sophie Patel: Draft snippet (will put in runbook):
```bash
# simple header fallback detection
if [ "$REDWOOD_SDK_VERSION" = "3" ]; then
  echo "Using legacy header, enable shim"
  export REDWOOD_USE_SHIM=true
fi
```
Alice Chen: Nice. Add explicit TTL for shim (no more than 90 days post-GA). We want to avoid permanent technical debt.
Miguel Santos: Timeline proposal: announce partners-only beta next Tue, start partner canary 4/1 -> 4/28, public deprecation notice 5/1, hard cutoff 6/30. Thoughts?
Ben Li: Engineering: 4/1 partner canary ok if we freeze major infra churn 3/25. Also need a fallback model routing in case auth failures spike; suggest auto-retry with older model variant for 5 minutes.
Jordan Park: Hardware partners confirmed their smoke matrices will land by Thu. They asked for a compatibility flag in the SDK response to surface quantization/ffi status — Sophie, can SDK include that?
Sophie Patel: Yes, will add response field: X-SDK-Compat: {"compat": "ok"} (proto in runbook). Keep it small.
Sara (Partner Success): I'll schedule a partner tabletop for next Wed with top-5 SIs and marketplace vendor reps. We should document expected FAQs: timeline, rollback, telemetry, billing impacts.
Alice Chen: Action items recap: Miguel = partner & marketplace comms + copy; Sophie = shim, snippet, compat field, test harness; Ben = infra fallback + feature toggle; Jordan = hardware smoke matrices; Sara = runbook + tabletop. Let's update the runbook PR and add a CHANGELOG entry.
Miguel Santos: I'll draft the partner email and marketplace banner today and share in #partnerships for review. @everyone please add any mandatory legal/marketing notes in-thread. :thumbsup:
Ben Li: I'll create the infra toggle PR and link the canary playbook. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sophie Patel: Opening runbook PR now — will include code examples, test checklist, and canary gating criteria.
Sara (Partner Success): Adding invite list for tabletop now.
Alice Chen: Thanks team. We'll treat this as 'breakguard ops' — keep comms tight, and avoid surprises for partners. If anything changes, ping me directly.
